description.value: A 58-site BC Parks campground in the Thompson River canyon near Lytton, sitting just off Highway 1 with potable water and washrooms; gate closes in the off-season so plan for a summer visit only.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Skihist Park is a real, active campground on Highway 1 in the Thompson Canyon area, publicly accessible and open for tent and RV camping. OSM tags provide explicit amenity data used here: drinking_water=yes supports Potable water=true; shower=no and washing_machine=no supply explicit negative evidence for Showers and Laundry respectively; the website's prominent 'Book camping' link contradicts OSM's reservation=no, so Reservations accepted is marked true per the website-over-OSM rule. No hiker/biker-specific sites or other cyclist amenities are mentioned in either source, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM reservation=no contradicts the BC Parks website's prominent 'Book camping' link; reservations are likely accepted.

OSM operator listed as 'Brandywine Environmental Management Ltd.' but the official website is BC Parks (env.gov.bc.ca); operator tag may refer to a maintenance contractor rather than the park authority.
Phone number +1-250-320-9305 in OSM could not be corroborated in the fetched website content.
Toilet type (flush vs. pit/vault) not specified in OSM tags or website content.
Email parkinquiries@telus.net appears to be a generic BC Parks inquiry address, not park-specific.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks campground on Highway 1 with tent camping; a useful and well-known overnight stop for touring cyclists traversing the Thompson Canyon corridor.

wow_evidence: sitting just off Highway 1 with potable water and washrooms
